verdict.rationale: Cua's docs describe named agents with "routines the daemon fires," which points to first-party, daemon-triggered recurring work rather than one-off runs. It is a single thin mention, though, and never says the routines run on a time schedule or how to define them. Missing for 10: explicit recurring schedule semantics (cron/interval/time-based triggers), documentation of how to create and manage routines, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
